reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2, E4) shows DCT improves strength and ductility in a related HfNbTaTiZr-based alloy via increased residual stress, but the hypothesis misattributes the mechanism to lattice distortion and residual stress improving ductility, whereas the cited paper attributes improvement to stress-induced phase transformation and defect evolution, not simply increased lattice distortion. Additionally, no evidence supports generalizing these effects to the distinct HfZrTiTa0.53 composition.
